newsitem.title: KENYA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN ELECT TO BAT AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN ELECT TO BAT AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: Pakistan won the toss and chose to bat first against South Africa in the final of the Kenyan centenary four-nation one-day cricket tournament at the Nairobi Gymkhana Club on Sunday.
South Africa - Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Derek Crookes, Brian McMillan, Pat Symcox, Dave Richardson, Fanie de Villiers, Allan Donald.
Pakistan - Saeed Anwar (captain), Salim Elahi, Shahid Afridi, Saeed Azad, Ijaz Ahmed, Ramiz Raja, Salim Malik, Moin Khan, Waqar Younis, Saqlain Mushtaq, Azhar Mahmood.
